title: Find a trusted program's shared libraries
goal: Connect a trusted executable to a resolved library and its package.
challenge: Inspect the bundled /usr/bin/cat, identify its libc dependency and package, and explain the loader cache/configuration. Do not run ldd on arbitrary downloaded executables or alter loader settings.

steps.command: w=/home/learner/ll-discovery-4; test "$(id -un)" = learner && test ! -e "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && mkdir -m 0700 -- "$w" && cd -- "$w" && test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 65536
steps.explanation: Create a fresh private workspace; stop on collision or insufficient space.
steps.expected: Exact learner path, no existing entry, at least64MiB free.

steps.command: guard() { local links; test "$(pwd -P)" = /home/learner/ll-discovery-4 && test ! -L /home/learner/ll-discovery-4 && test "$(stat -c %U .)" = learner && links=$(sudo find . -type l -print -quit) && test -z "$links"; }; guard
steps.expected: No path substitution; guest root can override guest safeguards.

steps.command: unrelated() { dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package}\t${Version}\t${db:Status-Status}\n' | awk '$1!="ll-discovery-data" && $1!="ll-discovery-report"'; }; unrelated > before.tsv; sudo sha256sum /etc/sudoers.d/learning-lab > sudo.before; id learner > learner.before; scope_ok() { guard && unrelated > after.tsv && cmp before.tsv after.tsv && sudo sha256sum -c sudo.before && id learner > learner.after && cmp learner.before learner.after; }; scope_ok
steps.explanation: Retain unrelated package and learner/sudo evidence before any transaction.
steps.expected: Protected unrelated state captured; stop on mismatch.

steps.explanation: ldd is for this known trusted program; do not inspect untrusted programs this way.
steps.expected: libc and loader paths; addresses vary and are not an assessment threshold.

steps.command: guard && { /sbin/ldconfig -p | grep -F libc.so.6; cat /etc/ld.so.conf; cat /etc/ld.so.conf.d/x86_64-linux-gnu.conf; } > loader.txt && cat loader.txt
steps.explanation: ldconfig -p prints the cache; it does not regenerate it.
steps.expected: Cache/configuration entries; no bare ldconfig or LD_LIBRARY_PATH changes.

steps.explanation: Merged /usr aliases can differ from package-record paths.
steps.expected: The libc6:amd64 owner of this canonical package path.

hints: Use ldconfig -p, not a cache update.
Library paths may resolve through merged /usr aliases.
Runtime addresses vary; identify dependency names and ownership.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 102.3 partial shared-library discovery. Self-reviewed, unscored; not complete objectives.
